public_status: Known signal (KOI K07393.01) with a proposed host reassignment, ready for expert review
release_status: ready for expert review (host attribution of a known signal)
novelty_note: The signal is KOI K07393.01, catalogued as a centroid-offset FALSE POSITIVE on the giant KIC 10976412. It is not a new signal. Whether the dwarf host attribution is already published is unconfirmed.
ephemeris_note: Frozen search value; descriptive discovery-quarter fit P 3.7593912 +/- 0.0000151 d is not holdout-validated.
duration_note: Search-grid minimum (0.05 d), not a fit.
radius_conditions: Only if the dwarf KIC 10976416 is the host (R* 0.58-0.61 R_sun).
host_test: The difference-image test assigned the dwarf in 12/12 quarters (9 supported by the stricter gate); per-star brightness test dwarf z 25.5 vs catalogued giant z -0.69. Injection controls 12/12.
limitations: Shape is unmeasured; a transit-shape check was run but the tool turned out to be invalid, so it is not used.
A blend within 1-2 arcsec (dm <= 7.6) and an eclipsing binary at twice the period are not excluded.
Faint sources at 12-14 arcsec lie outside the pixel model; the stellar radius could be wrong.
open_questions: K-band AO/speckle 0.1-3 arcsec, then a spectrum and a false-positive probability.
